editorial: The software world today focuses on personal AI infrastructure and memory management of autonomous agents. Open source tools on GitHub show that modular systems where users can create their own skill sets are rapidly developing.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: Last30days-skill offers an artificial intelligence skill (AI skill) that synthesizes current data by researching on platforms such as Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News and Polymarket. This Python-based tool combines information from different sources to create grounded summaries for users.

items.title: CopilotKit/CopilotKit
items.summary: CopilotKit offers an end-to-end framework for developing artificial intelligence agents and generative UIs. This tool, which integrates with React, Angular and mobile platforms, allows developers to build in-application artificial intelligence experiences over a standard protocol.

items.title: MemPalace/mempalace
items.summary: MemPalace offers an open source and performance-oriented memory management infrastructure for artificial intelligence systems. The system provides developers with a free toolset to optimize the long-term information storage and retrieval processes of AI models.

items.title: danielmiessler/Personal_AI_Infrastructure
items.summary: Personal AI Infrastructure provides a framework for creating agent-based artificial intelligence (agent AI) systems designed to augment human capabilities. Developed with TypeScript, this structure supports a modular architecture that allows users to manage their own autonomous workflows.

items.title: openai/plugins
items.summary: OpenAI plug-ins enable language models to access up-to-date data and interact directly with third-party applications. This structure allows artificial intelligence models to perform complex tasks using external tools.

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.summary: Agent-Reach is an open source tool that enables AI agents to search and read content across various platforms on the internet. Working via a command line interface (CLI), this system offers data access without paying any application programming interface (API) fees.

items.title: sveltejs/svelte
items.summary: Unlike traditional frameworks, Svelte uses a compile-time approach that reduces runtime overhead on the browser. This JavaScript library simplifies web development processes by converting application code into small and fast-running pure JavaScript modules.

items.title: nginx/nginx
items.summary: The NGINX open source repository continues to be developed in C as a high-performance web server and reverse proxy. The software offers a standard solution in large-scale infrastructures to manage network traffic and optimize content distribution.

items.title: aquasecurity/trivy
items.summary: Trivy is a comprehensive security tool that performs vulnerability scanning, misconfiguration checking, and software bill of materials (SBOM) generation across containers, Kubernetes clusters, and cloud infrastructures. Developed with the Go language, this open source solution provides a central platform to detect security risks throughout the software development lifecycle.

items.title: golang/go
items.summary: Developed by Google, the Go programming language is an open source system programming language designed to create high-performance and scalable software. It is widely preferred in modern cloud computing infrastructures with its concurrency management and fast compilation times.

items.title: lfnovo/open-notebook
items.summary: Open-notebook offers an open-source alternative to the Google NotebookLM tool, giving users greater flexibility and customization. This platform, developed with TypeScript, supports interactive analysis and content production processes over documents with local or customizable infrastructures.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: Superpowers is a framework and methodology used to build agent-based skills in software development processes. This structure, developed in Shell language, aims to standardize the workflows of autonomous systems.

items.title: santifer/career-ops
items.summary: Using the Claude Code infrastructure, career-ops automates artificial intelligence-supported job search processes with 14 different skill modes. The system centralizes functions such as batch management and resume creation through a Go-based control panel.

items.title: openai/whisper
items.summary: Developed by OpenAI, Whisper is a speech recognition model trained by large-scale weak supervision learning method. It offers high accuracy rates in converting and translating multilingual audio data into text.

items.title: vitejs/vite
items.summary: Vite offers a fast development environment and build tool for modern web projects. It functions as a frontend tooling tool that reduces waiting times in the development process by using native ES modules.

items.title: microsoft/mxc
items.summary: Developed by Microsoft, MXC is a policy-based, layered isolation and containment solution written in Rust language. It is designed to safely limit system resources and increase application security.

items.title: PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
items.summary: Developed by PaddlePaddle, PaddleOCR is a lightweight optical character recognition tool that converts text in image and PDF files into structured data. Supporting more than 100 languages, this library makes it easy to process documents with large language models.

items.title: microsoft/VibeVoice
items.summary: Published by Microsoft, VibeVoice was developed as an open source voice AI framework. With its Python-based structure, the system allows users to train their own sound models and integrate them into their applications.

items.title: Ask HN: What was your "oh shit" moment with GenAI?
items.summary: While developers initially thought that generative AI tools were simple entertainment or limited coding support, their views changed when they saw the models' ability to solve complex problems. This process is based on experience showing that the technical capabilities of large language models are improving faster than expected.

items.title: Meta confirms 1000s of Instagram accounts were hacked by abusing its AI chatbot
items.summary: Meta confirmed that thousands of Instagram accounts were compromised as a result of misuse of an artificial intelligence chatbot (AI chatbot). Attackers gained unauthorized access to user accounts by using vulnerabilities in the system.

items.title: Ntsc-rs – open-source video emulation of analog TV and VHS artifacts
items.summary: ntsc-rs is an open source video emulation tool that transfers image distortions specific to analog television and video cassette (VHS) signals to the digital environment. The software uses a variety of filtering techniques to apply the visual texture of legacy broadcast standards to modern digital content.

items.title: Pokemon Emerald Ported to WebAssembly (100k FPS)
items.summary: Pokemon Emerald game was run with high performance on the web-based operating environment (WebAssembly). Thanks to optimization efforts, the game reached a high speed of 100 thousand frames per second (100k FPS).

items.title: Moving beyond fork() + exec()
items.summary: The fork and exec mechanism, which is the process creation method in operating systems, is being replaced by more modern and efficient process spawning techniques. This approach aims to reduce performance losses and manage system resources more effectively, especially in applications with large memory areas.

items.title: nvidia/LocateAnything-3B
items.summary: Developed by Nvidia, LocateAnything-3B works as an image-text-to-text model that performs object localization tasks by processing visual and textual inputs. The model supports object detection and analysis processes with text-based queries on complex visual data.

items.title: google/gemma-4-12B-it
items.summary: Developed by Google, gemma-4-12B-it is a multi-modal (any-to-any) artificial intelligence model that can process different types of data. The model offers flexibility in various application areas with the ability to process text and visual data simultaneously.

items.title: unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF
items.summary: The Gemma-4-12b-it model, optimized by Unsloth, offers a multimodal structure that can process visual and text-based data. Thanks to the GGUF format, this model can run more efficiently on local hardware with low memory usage.

items.title: google/gemma-4-12B
items.summary: Developed by Google, Gemma-4-12B offers a multi-modal (any-to-any) model structure that can process different data types. This model provides a flexible usage area by processing text and other data formats through a single architecture.

items.title: ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8
items.summary: Ideogram-4-fp8, developed by Ideogram, is a model used in text-to-image processes. Floating point precision is optimized in 8-bit (floating point 8) format, providing more efficient operating performance.
